name: Repeat & Burst
description: Conditions on a topic's recent history: 'not seen recently' to calm flapping alerts, 'burst' to catch a storm.

permissionReasons.history.read: Looks at this topic's recent messages to see whether the same alert already came in.

providers.name: Not seen recently
providers.description: True when no message with the same title (or text) arrived in the last N minutes.

providers.name: Burst
providers.description: True when at least N messages (optionally with the same title) arrived in the last M minutes.
